lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a non-uniform grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form visible grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel to the dorsal axis, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located toward the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-intensity white irregular marking is visible near the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin, suggesting localized tissue variation or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-frequency white spots on the dorsal leading edge and surface of the pectoral fin.
